Cards are dealt counter-clockwise in batches (3-2-3 or 4-4). Each player receives 8 cards.

items.text: Kontra / Rekontra / Szubkontra: Before play, defenders may say kontra to double hand score; contractor may rekontra; defenders may szubkontra (8×). Does not apply on throw-in hands.

Throw-in melds: If any player holds a meld worth 100+ points (four of a kind or sequence of 5+), they must declare; hand is thrown in and meld points scored. Concealment penalized: opponents score 161.
Maccs (double game): If a team reaches 501 when opponents have less than 251, winners score a double game (maccs).
